Testing & Refinement

The 24 Solar Terms are a traditional East Asian calendrical system. Rather than measuring time only through numbers, it describes time through transformation in the nature: the first rain of spring, the arrival of frost, ect. Historically, the 24 Solar Terms were used to guide agricultural labor, helping people know when to sow, harvest, prepare, or adapt to environmental change. Over time, they also became embedded in everyday life through food customs, poetry and festivals.
